result.response:
The bug in [`Complex.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/complex/Complex.java) was that [`add(Complex rhs)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/complex/Complex.java#L150-L157) did not check whether `this.isNaN` or `rhs.isNaN` was true before performing component-wise addition, resulting in a complex number with a finite real part when adding a complex number with a NaN imaginary part.

### Solution
1. Updated [`Complex.add(Complex rhs)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/complex/Complex.java#L150-L157) to check `if (isNaN || rhs.isNaN)` and return [`Complex.NaN`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/complex/Complex.java#L56).
2. Saved the source modifications patch to [`enlightened_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_d_fix/enlightened_fix.patch).
3. Verified that `CucumberTest` and `ComplexTest` pass completely.
